name: workbench
description: Explicitly invoked Workbench skills for evidence briefs, decision dialogue, scoped execution, OpenAPI, visual grounding, and dev wiki context.

interface.shortDescription: Shape, report, and execute scoped work.
interface.longDescription: Workbench provides explicitly invoked skills for Codex: organize Jira/Figma/API/user evidence, clarify goals and completion conditions through dialogue, execute a Goal Contract with project dev wiki context, and verify the result with tests, API checks, or UI grounding when requested.
defaultPrompt: Use $workbench:brainstorm to clarify a goal and prepare a Goal Contract.
Use $workbench:executor to execute an explicit goal with completion checks.
Use $workbench:openapi to register, inspect, or test a Swagger/OpenAPI service.
